- SYNTHETIC SUMMIT
, exhibition event by the Computer Lars collective, in connection with Asker Bryld Staunæs
artistic research project between Kunsthal Aarhus and Aarhus University

In a time when global discussions on the regulation of artificial intelligence bring politicians,
businesspeople and lobbyists to swarm in the world's conference centers, the
traditional political understandings of who or what should and can hold
decision-making power are challenged. A new question has arisen: If artificial intelligence were to take over
the government, how would it govern? Can humans even understand that the machine
governs when we see it? And what forms and principles could guide these new digital
entities to navigate across international as well as planetary conflicts and
interest areas?

Spring 2025 marks the opening at Kunsthal Aarhus of the very first Synthetic Summit – an
exhibition event that brings together the world's leading AI parties and virtual political actors to
develop an AI-driven world order. Curated by the artist group Computer Lars, the
Danish collective behind The Synthetic Party, Synthetic Summit invites planning of a new
world government with artificial intelligence.

Through immersive performance artworks, computer sculptures and media spectacle
Synthetic Summit transforms Kunsthal Aarhus' basement into a stage where both generic
parliamentarism and cacophonic conference negotiations take place. The event reflects
and simulates the global discussion about AI's role in society, rewriting the
political and principled frameworks for a modern democracy. With ongoing live expositions
from leading AI parties and virtual politicians, Synthetic Summit invites both population and
powers that be to experience an international line-up including:
